outputs.contract: bounded leaf or explicit refusal, not canonical completion

acceptance: Preset role→provider candidate→capability/readiness→grant limits→saved config; nothing started until Task admission.
Unfilled role is honest; current system login usable if certified; managed multi-account is optional.
Immutable AgentReadyReceipt at native tier; command/output, source commit, actual missing checks and stop/resume recorded. All named negatives exercised.
guards: Нет принятого producer/типизированного контракта: вернуть конкретный вопрос upstream, не придумывать store.
Изменился baseline source digest: rebase и semantic re-review; не применять blind patch.
Нет upstream receipt или оно только prototype, когда нужен runtime: packet не dispatchable.
Выход за write candidates или scope/grant: сначала обновить конкретный boundary; не расширять молча.
Source HEAD or dependency receipt digest changed: rebase and semantic review before dispatch.
Exact file owner or required scope/grant unavailable: stop, send evidence + affected current tasks to lead; no speculative store or authority.
Native/user proof unavailable: record NOT_RUN/blocked; pure green cannot consume higher-tier edge.
Stop before implementation until a bounded leaf and upstream acceptance/authority are approved; a planning dependency is not a completion receipt.
resume: Прочитать README → contracts → packet → upstream receipts. Зафиксировать base/head, dirty status, lease и exact next failing check.
